_comment: Which OSM tags a region pack keeps in `osm_pois.tags_json`.
Consumed by scripts/osm-to-search-sqlite.py; asserted against the keys the
Everything else is dropped at build time. On a dense metro the full tag
maps were 87% of the pack's search-index payload, and most of it is never
`orientation` and friends are render/QA metadata, not search metadata.
Why families as well as keys: the app reads whole namespaces, not just the
members that exist today. `payment:*` is iterated from a label map,
`diet:*` from a checklist, `addr:*` from address formatting. Listing every
member would mean a new `payment:alipay` silently vanishing from the POI
card until someone remembered to update this file, so those prefixes are
_exact: Tag keys read by name somewhere in src/. A key missing here that the app reads is a silently empty field on device.
_prefixes: Tag namespaces kept whole, because the app reads them as a family rather than by member.
